items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A vial of red liquid that shimmers when agitated. Heals 2d4+2 hit points when consumed.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A wooden rod wrapped in cloth soaked in pitch. Provides bright light in a 20-foot radius.

items.name: Rope (50 ft)
items.description: Hempen rope, 50 feet in length. Has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

items.name: Longsword +1
items.description: A finely crafted longsword that grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

items.name: Ring of Protection
items.description: A golden ring set with a small sapphire. While wearing this ring, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.
